MRI Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Pylon DBS System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
• Static magnetic field of ≤ 3 T
• Maximum spatial field gradient of 25 T/m (2500 G/cm) or less
• B1+rms must not exceed 1.7 μT; when B1+rms is not displayed, use a whole body SAR of 1 W/kg or less
• Scanning in the Normal Operating Mode of operation for the MR system
• Limit total active scanning to 15 min
• RF excitation: circularly polarized (CP) only
• Device configuration: MRI mode ON
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Pylon DBS System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.4 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
